title: Stacked swap
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity image concept for Pecu transaction previews. This is a design exploration, fictional sample data, not a real financial quote. Landscape 1536x1024 canvas, front-on flat UI screenshot, no perspective, no devices, no desk or scene. A small unobtrusive outside-artboard caption with concept number/name and "Sample data"; the UI itself has no slogans, hero, ornamental badges, fake live dots, marketing prose or mascot. User explicitly wants amber-minimal colors and typography WITH claymation depth on controls. White #ffffff background and cards, near-black #262626 text, pale cool gray secondary surfaces, amber #f59e0b primary controls with BLACK text, restrained amber-brown links. Inter typography and JetBrains Mono tabular amounts. Soft sculpted white clay panels, 22px rounded corners, softly raised tactile amber buttons with top-left highlight and bottom-right contact shadow, occasional gently recessed amount wells. Depth should clearly read as clay, not glass, gradient art, shiny plastic, or flat wireframe. Crisp highly readable realistic UI type and generous consistent spacing. Buttons minimum 44px, labels sentence case. Omit 3D mascot because this is focused transaction component exploration. Show only 1-3 transaction examples unless variation explicitly requests four; component must fill most of frame. All metadata subordinate to value movement, all text aligned. Base sample swap: title "Review swap", Pay "0.05 ETH", "Estimated receive" "120.00 USDC", "Minimum received" "119.40 USDC", "Network" "Base", "Network fee" "Not estimated", "Expires" "14:32", primary "Confirm swap", secondary "Cancel". Transfer sample: "Send USDC", "250.00 USDC", "To" "0x71C7…976F", "Network" "Base", "Network fee" "Not estimated", "Confirm send", "Cancel". Approval sample: "Approve USDC", "Spending limit" "150.00 USDC", "Spender" "0x1234…5678", "Network" "Base", "Confirm approval", "Cancel". Use only relevant fields for each action. Never imply estimates are guaranteed, never invent zero fees or live safety claims. Distinct structure as specified below, same theme across all concepts.
Concept 01-stacked-swap: Stacked swap. Direction: A compact vertical chat card. Two broad recessed amount wells stacked vertically, joined by a small raised circular down-arrow. Pay and Receive typography dominates. Narrow metadata rows below. Single amber Confirm swap button alongside quiet Cancel. Main card swap, small companion token approval card.
